how: Calls direct members to coordinates and renew requests for people while the logo is being restored.

Shared automation increases available hands only if people adopt it, so reported non-adoption motivates a more approachable browser version.
A script's target remains negotiable through image substitution, relocation, and possible overlap rather than mechanically fixing the group's design.

how: A school comparison turns possession of a canvas spot into a boast about the familiar rival.
Existing school belonging appears through a boast and its correction rather than a broader political or ideological campaign.
The school boast supplies no attack call, while encroachment proposals target other work, leaving the asserted prior-rivalry attack mechanism untested.
Admiring another host's April Fools redesign supports reception of play but cannot establish that this host staged the takeover or treated canvas calls as jokes.
A member directs a separate border discussion into the existing canvas thread.
Concentrating discussion can take the small form of redirecting one border post without establishing a moderator rule or a canvas-post flood.
Participants celebrate getting a recognizable community mark onto the canvas.
A post-closure comment records that the logo moved after another group overtook it.
The late recounting supplies no decision about carrying the effort onward.
Members propose taking existing neighboring work to obtain space without demonstrating that each proposed takeover happened.
A school-comparison boast supplies unilateral rivalry talk without demonstrating reciprocal taunts between rooms.

The accepted permission exchange supplies no coded dispute over who can bind all placers.
The late turn recounts relocation, while the correction about the rival's mark occurs before closure rather than contesting a preserved version afterward.
Calls and progress reports coexist without identifying which call caused particular members to build.

Reporting a standing basic design is followed by efforts to protect it, although building and upkeep remain interleaved.

An accepted non-overwriting offer does not show subsequent compliance caused by the agreement.
The visible threat prompts defensive reconfiguration of an already announced script, not demonstrated first adoption or increased participation.
Celebration marks provisional recovery while maintenance continues, so it cannot be treated as evidence that building has finished.
Celebration precedes the late report of displacement, but no coded passage makes celebration the cause of recording.
The late report is not followed in this coded record by a decision to preserve an ongoing collective effort.
The record attributes relocation to being overtaken without establishing too few hands as the causal judgment behind moving.
A posted target makes a suggestion actionable but settles the design only provisionally because defense can explicitly withdraw it.
One bare agreement does not test the general preference for joins over refusals or reveal acceptances expressed only by placing.
Neighborly greetings do not establish that a shortage of defenders elicited transferred pixel labor.
A non-overwriting agreement and separate welcomes do not establish a border-talk channel producing traded help.
Recruitment and encroachment proposals are visible but do not establish that recruiting itself caused the attack orientation.

The school boast and the takeover proposals concern different targets, leaving the proposed attack-to-rivalry-talk link unsupported.
Defense and neighbor greetings supply no coded transition into a coalition.
